prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose game-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art character sheet for the advanced practice provider in Image 2. Image 1 controls only established GS026 pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image 2 controls every identity and outfit detail:36-year-old adult man,deep brown skin,close-cropped black twists,short tidy moustache,lean build,hip-length full-sleeved white clinical coat over cobalt-blue scrubs, matching cobalt trousers,charcoal clinical sneakers and small plain unlettered chest badge. Preserve every detail in all eight poses.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows and four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters and generous row gap; every head and shoe fully visible. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs with knees bent around90degrees,hands naturally on thighs,feet flat; nochair visible. Same head/body scale and outfit in all poses; keep clinical coat sleeves full-length to wrists, coat hem resting naturally over hips while seated.
Style/medium: soft rounded high-quality pixel art matching Image1,compact friendly proportions,crisp dark pixel-stepped outline and softly textured shading.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no hat,stethoscope,equipment,held props,chair,furniture,floor,shadow,glow,background,logo,text,readable badge,watermark,labels,grid,duplicate/missing/cropped pose.
